replies.body:
# HELP tensorfold:requests_total HTTP replies by API key label and status.
# TYPE tensorfold:requests_total counter
tensorfold:requests_total{key="unauthenticated",status="200"} 1
# HELP tensorfold:requests_running Requests in prefill or decode.
# TYPE tensorfold:requests_running gauge
tensorfold:requests_running 0
# HELP tensorfold:requests_waiting Requests queued or held until a lane is free.
# TYPE tensorfold:requests_waiting gauge
tensorfold:requests_waiting 0
# HELP tensorfold:prompt_tokens_total Prompt tokens of finished requests.
# TYPE tensorfold:prompt_tokens_total counter
tensorfold:prompt_tokens_total 0
# HELP tensorfold:generation_tokens_total Generated tokens of finished requests.
# TYPE tensorfold:generation_tokens_total counter
tensorfold:generation_tokens_total 0
# HELP tensorfold:kv_cache_usage_ratio Tokens in a stream cache divided by that stream's context window.
# TYPE tensorfold:kv_cache_usage_ratio gauge
tensorfold:kv_cache_usage_ratio{pool="0"} 0
# HELP tensorfold:mtp_drafted_total Draft tokens verified on finished requests.
# TYPE tensorfold:mtp_drafted_total counter
tensorfold:mtp_drafted_total 0
# HELP tensorfold:mtp_accepted_total Draft tokens kept on finished requests.
# TYPE tensorfold:mtp_accepted_total counter
tensorfold:mtp_accepted_total 0
# HELP tensorfold:request_latency_seconds Seconds from arrival to the reply leaving.
# TYPE tensorfold:request_latency_seconds histogram
tensorfold:request_latency_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf"} 0
tensorfold:request_latency_seconds_sum <sum>
tensorfold:request_latency_seconds_count 0
# HELP tensorfold:time_to_first_token_seconds Seconds from arrival to the first generated token.
# TYPE tensorfold:time_to_first_token_seconds histogram
tensorfold:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf"} 0
tensorfold:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum <sum>
tensorfold:time_to_first_token_seconds_count 0
# HELP tensorfold:request_decode_seconds Seconds a finished request spent decoding. Its sum over generation_tokens_total is the decode rate.
# TYPE tensorfold:request_decode_seconds histogram
tensorfold:request_decode_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf"} 0
tensorfold:request_decode_seconds_sum <sum>
tensorfold:request_decode_seconds_count 0
# HELP tensorfold:process_footprint_bytes This process's physical footprint as the OS counts it, Metal buffers included; only where the platform reports one (macOS).
# TYPE tensorfold:process_footprint_bytes gauge
tensorfold:process_footprint_bytes <n>
# HELP tensorfold:num_requests_running Requests in prefill or decode. A mirror of tensorfold:requests_running.
# TYPE tensorfold:num_requests_running gauge
tensorfold:num_requests_running 0
# HELP tensorfold:num_requests_waiting Requests queued or held until a lane is free. A mirror of tensorfold:requests_waiting.
# TYPE tensorfold:num_requests_waiting gauge
tensorfold:num_requests_waiting 0
# HELP tensorfold:kv_cache_usage_perc A stream's cache occupancy under vLLM's name; same streams and ratios as tensorfold:kv_cache_usage_ratio.
# TYPE tensorfold:kv_cache_usage_perc gauge
tensorfold:kv_cache_usage_perc{stream="0"} 0
# HELP tensorfold:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total Draft tokens verified on finished requests, this server's single draft counter.
# TYPE tensorfold:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total counter
tensorfold:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total 0
# HELP tensorfold:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total Draft tokens kept on finished requests.
# TYPE tensorfold:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total counter
tensorfold:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total 0
# HELP tensorfold:e2e_request_latency_seconds Seconds from arrival to the reply leaving, under vLLM's name.
# TYPE tensorfold:e2e_request_latency_seconds histogram
tensorfold:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf"} 0
tensorfold:e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum <sum>
tensorfold:e2e_request_latency_seconds_count 0
# HELP tensorfold:request_decode_time_seconds Seconds a finished request spent decoding, under vLLM's name.
# TYPE tensorfold:request_decode_time_seconds histogram
tensorfold:request_decode_time_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf"} 0
tensorfold:request_decode_time_seconds_sum <sum>
tensorfold:request_decode_time_seconds_count 0
# HELP tensorfold:client_disconnections_total Requests a client left before the reply left the server.
# TYPE tensorfold:client_disconnections_total counter
tensorfold:client_disconnections_total 0
# HELP tensorfold:preemptions_total Requests that had to give a lane up to a later one.
# TYPE tensorfold:preemptions_total counter
tensorfold:preemptions_total 0
